payload.artist_html:
Gerald Mayr, James L. Goedert, Vanesa L. de Pietri, R. Paul Scofield. Photographs by Sven Tränkner.

Modifications made to crop out and reunite photographs attributed to the same species.
payload.credit_html: Mayr, G, Goedert, JL, De Pietri, VL, Scofield, RP. Comparative osteology of the penguin-like mid-Cenozoic Plotopteridae and the earliest true fossil penguins, with comments on the origins of wing-propelled diving. J Zool Syst Evol Res. 2021; 59: 264– 276. https://doi.org/10.1111/jzs.12400
payload.description_html: Right femur in caudal (a) and distal (c) view, and distal end of the tibiotarsus (e) of Olympidytes thieli, a tonsaline plotopterid from the Oligocene of the Washington State. Size bar = 10 mm.
